title: Siege of Zierikzee
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Zierikzee", at revision 1370746590, opens: "The siege of Zierikzee was a siege in the Eighty Years' War between October 1575 and July 1576." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2139412, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1575-1576 siege in the Eighty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
